summary: New editor hook WorldColorTraceEditor ([InitializeOnLoad] plus an AssetModificationProcessor): it puts back every asset the runtime world colour painter touched when play ends or before a save during play, and clears their dirty flag. It is a reader of play state only and writes no asset of its own.
why: WorldColorTrace paints materials and prefab assets in memory so spawned objects are born in the worn colour set; in the editor those are project assets and must never keep a set's colours.
